killed.claim: appendLine glued a new row onto an existing ledger's last line when that line lacked a trailing newline
killed.evidence: Executed repro: seeded a tmp root .claude/spec-runs.jsonl with one valid escape row and no trailing newline (verified via od -c, last byte was } not newline), then ran node spec/scripts/escape-row.js --append --root <tmp> --row <second valid row> -> exit 0, stdout appended spec=specs/second.md file=second.js. Result file has 2 lines, both independently JSON.parse-able, each parses back to the exact original object. Repeated for --amend: seeded ledger with one valid escape row and no trailing newline, ran --amend --escape-ts ... --class silent-fallback -> exit 0, result file has 2 lines (stage escape, stage escape-class), both parse independently. Also confirmed AC-20260901-07-3 unaffected: appending to an EMPTY existing file and to a NO-FILE root both still produce exactly JSON.stringify(row) + newline with no leading separator. node --test tests/escape/escape-row.test.js passes all 9 tests including the two new regression tests for this fix.
